name: Bala-30B-A3B
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507 (config.json max_position_embeddings 262144). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507: 48 full GQA layers (kv heads 4, head_dim 128) and 0 other layers, per the base config.json.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-30. A distillation of Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507, not a new base model: same config.json, 30.532B parameters against the base record's 30.5B - a rounding or label difference, not extra weights, and the tensor set is the base's. Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-09-06. Method: QLoRA (4-bit NF4 base, LoRA on q/k/v/o_proj only, MoE expert MLPs frozen) merged into the base weights; the repo ships both merged weights and adapters. Single-seed, no variance reported, and the card says coding is not improved.
